study type: Experimental study (device development and testing in vitro and in vivo using an animal model)
exposure: Sprayed umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells
cohort: An excisional cutaneous wound model (animal model).
finding: The novel pneumatically assisted atomization device (PAAD) uniformly delivered living cells while maintaining their viability and differentiation, and the application of sprayed umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells using this device significantly accelerated wound healing and promoted appendage regeneration on an excisional cutaneous wound model.
